messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":6,"verses":[{"chapter":6,"verse":26,"text":"Then he went of from behind my wife and placed himself before me crying and he said : Behold, Job, I yield and give way to thee who art but flesh while I am a spirit."},{"chapter":6,"verse":27,"text":"Thou art plague-stricken, but I am in great trouble."},{"chapter":6,"verse":28,"text":"For I am like a wrestler contesting with a wrestler who has, in a single-handed combat, torn down his antagonist and covered him with dust and broken every limb of his, whereas the other one who lies beneath, having displayed his bravery, gives forth sounds of triumph testifying to his own superior excellence."},{"chapter":6,"verse":29,"text":"Thus thou, O Job, art beneath and stricken with plague and pain, and yet thou hast carried the victory in the wrestling-match with me, and behold, I yield to thee\"."},{"chapter":6,"verse":30,"text":"Then he left me abashed."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 26,27,28,29,30 in this chapter.
